blocks.age_intro: RENDER THE PERSON AT THIS AGE, which the reference images do not all agree on — they were made across a span of years and some show them noticeably older or younger. Take face shape, features, colouring and proportions from the references, but take the AGE from here, including how grey the hair and stubble are and how deep the lines read:
blocks.backdrop_body: White seamless studio backdrop with a soft contact shadow at the feet, no floor line, no props, no text.
blocks.backdrop_face: Flat mid-grey seamless studio backdrop, no floor line, no props, no text.
blocks.build_intro: THE BUILD IS THE PERSON'S, NOT THE GUIDE FIGURE'S — and unlike the face, the reference images may barely show it, since a reference pool is mostly head-and-shoulders. So take the build from THIS DESCRIPTION first, never from the pose guide, and do not reshape it toward the guide in any direction — not thinner, not thicker, not taller, not shorter. NOTHING in this description governs the FACE: where it mentions hair it means BODY hair, and it must not change the facial hair, its length or its style — those come from the reference images and the identity cues below:
blocks.face_intro: THE FACE COMES FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGES. They show this person's real face: match its bone structure, the WIDTH of the jaw and chin, the set and spacing of the eyes, the nose, the hairline and the shape of the skull to them. The identity cues listed further down are a checklist to verify against those images, not a replacement for looking at them — where a written cue and an image disagree about the FACE, the images win.
blocks.face_only: THE FACE COMES FROM THE REFERENCE IMAGES. They show this person's real face: match its bone structure, the WIDTH of the jaw and chin, the set and spacing of the eyes, the nose, the hairline and the shape of the skull to them. Study the nose closely, and preserve the person's ethnicity exactly as the images show it.
blocks.guide: is a POSE GUIDE ONLY. Match its stance, the direction the body and head face, and its framing. Take nothing else from it — not its build, proportions, skin, head, face or hair, and do not blend it into the person.
blocks.guide_torso: is a SECOND POSE GUIDE, for the TORSO ONLY. Copy the angle of its shoulders and chest relative to the camera, and nothing else — not its framing, crop, head, face, hair, build, proportions or clothing. Do not blend it into the person and do not draw the whole figure it shows.
blocks.light: Soft frontal key with gentle falloff, even and near-shadowless on the subject, no hard shadow edges, no colour cast.
blocks.minimal: Wearing plain, close-fitting, unbranded dark shorts and nothing else, so the build, proportions and posture read clearly
blocks.must_intro_body: Preserve these identity cues exactly — but the wardrobe named above governs this angle image, so ignore any clothing rule among them:
blocks.quality: Clean and sharp, evenly lit, the whole subject in frame and in focus, no filter, no vignette, no added grain, no border.
blocks.scale_face: SCALE, held constant across the whole set: the crown of the head sits just below the top edge of the frame with only a small margin above it, and the head occupies roughly the upper third of the image. Do not zoom in closer on some angles than others.
blocks.style_fallback: whatever medium the reference images are in
blocks.style_intro: Render in the SAME MEDIUM and visual style as the reference images of the person — do not convert them into another medium. Their style is
blocks.turn_check: A TRUE forty-five degrees, not a slight turn: the far cheek is partly hidden behind the bridge of the nose, the far ear is out of view, and the near ear is fully visible. BOTH eyes look directly into the lens — the gaze does not drift off camera.
blocks.turn_check_face: A TRUE forty-five degrees, not a slight turn: the far cheek is partly hidden behind the bridge of the nose, the far ear is out of view, and the near ear is fully visible.
